reads: force flag, directory existence, input file/configuration
exceptions: Load errors abort; selected fresh branch performs no load/reload.
dependency_conclusion: Current selected input must be fresh; non-replay alone is insufficient.

writes: prepared persistent task, prover call/runtime state
exceptions: Preparation errors/interruptions follow actual caller catches; no artifact recovery.
dependency_conclusion: Required proof input is the live task, not XML/shapes or serialized prover IDs.

writes: save state, then report message set
exceptions: Escaping timed-save exception prevents report_messages; ending is not retried.
dependency_conclusion: Save completion/control is a current dependency even though saved contents are not.

reads: live forest/raw tasks, current shape state during partial/resumed paths
writes: shape maps, n, per-goal shapes, shape_version; fresh identifiers/runtime effects
exceptions: Nested signal and local catches may leave nontransactional relationships.
dependency_conclusion: Semantic inverse/association invariant is for later matching; typed/bounded operations remain current requirements.

reads: per-goal checksum table or dummy default
writes: output checksum text; direct save does not modify session_sum_table
exceptions: Lookup default may affect output; no current proof-result checksum read.
dependency_conclusion: Saved association matters for later matching/obsolescence, not current result projection.

reads: theory/file cache, emptiness of goal/theory lists
writes: missing th_state/file_state entries may be populated
exceptions: Operations can fail or catch Not_found; raw-forest preservation is not all-state preservation.
dependency_conclusion: Current Gnat check validity reads pn_state/tn_state and attempts, not these upper caches.

reads: live proof attempts, separate serialized prover-ID map
writes: prover-ID map and local serialization context/header
exceptions: Search/allocation/printing can fail; numeric representation must fit.
dependency_conclusion: Current reporting uses live prover records/names; correct ID-to-header association is needed on reload.

reads: session directory, existing paths, serialization values
writes: backups, open/truncated XML/shapes, channel state; session_dir_for_save assignment
exceptions: No encompassing cleanup/finally; I/O failure can prevent normal result JSON.
dependency_conclusion: Current path does not read contents back; completed files are not thereby certified reusable.

reads: explmap/check registry, live goal/transform/attempt/status records, prover names; diagnostics/timings
exceptions: Exceptions or interruption may prevent/alter reporting; no successful-report conclusion follows from artifact nondependence.
dependency_conclusion: No saved XML/shape/numeric prover-ID read supplies current proof-result values.

writes: proof bookkeeping and .spark report, or fatal error
exceptions: Wait success alone is not proof; error/invalid response is fatal.
dependency_conclusion: Consumes result protocol, not saved session XML/shapes.

reads: fresh workspace, native result/report files, source/library identities
writes: strict report audit and build decision
exceptions: Missing/incomplete reports and failed proof command reject build.
dependency_conclusion: Existing implementation is not future optional confirmation; no saved-session proof audit.

reads: XML goal order, shape version, dictionary, per-goal checksum/indices
exceptions: Some shape errors warn/fallback; no general restoration proof.
dependency_conclusion: Real dependency for later reuse, including non-replay runs that load an existing directory.

reads: numeric header IDs/default limits and serialized proof results
writes: reconstructed and merged live prover attempts
exceptions: Missing ID errors; malformed/colliding association is not certified safe.
dependency_conclusion: Correct correspondence is required before using saved results in a later run.

reads: same live controller/session, signal disposition and pending/runtime state
writes: save prefix, ignore dispositions, exit gates or error JSON
exceptions: Handler exits or raises; higher catches can continue. No no-signal premise and no universal caught-interrupt detector.
dependency_conclusion: Can occur during proof; not an automatically observation-only operation.

exceptions: Finally may replace the original exception; values/counters need their own bounds.
dependency_conclusion: Artifact semantics do not remove these current effects or assure whole JSON equality.

reads: private field uses and explicit public callers
exceptions: Text search is navigation only, not a reachability/semantic proof.
dependency_conclusion: Use the source argument for the selected path; do not generalize to arbitrary controller clients.
